findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: every source TextLine of the retained pages is either retained, excluded by a recorded decision, or unaccounted; every manifest line is found in the PAGE-XML
findings.interpretation_limits: a non-zero count would mean the audit cannot map source lines to the benchmark

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: source TextLines (geometry) on retained pages carrying non-empty GT
findings.interpretation_limits: Every page was run through a recognition model (Creator: Jaemtlands_domsagas_M1), which fills every line. Line coverage therefore cannot distinguish corrected from uncorrected text (see T1-T4).

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: retained pages where every source line carries GT
findings.interpretation_limits: same limit as C1

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: pages whose reading-order sequence ends in >= 2 lines without GT
findings.interpretation_limits: same limit as C1

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: runs of lines without GT between lines with GT (internal gaps)
findings.interpretation_limits: same limit as C1

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: GT lines with <= 3 non-space chars
findings.interpretation_limits: short lines are usually genuine (numbers, catchwords, 'd.', single words); they are listed, not concluded

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: text regions with no lines or no line carrying GT
findings.interpretation_limits: a region without lines may be a layout-analysis artefact, not an untranscribed text block

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: region type labels (PAGE @type or structure tag)
findings.interpretation_limits: without type labels, marginalia/headings can only be approximated geometrically (R3)

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: regions narrower than 0.25 of the page width (possible marginalia/headings) and their GT coverage
findings.interpretation_limits: narrow regions carry GT at the same rate as main regions if coverage is ~100%; no omitted region type

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: regions with unsegmented space below their last line >= 3.0 x median line height (text that may have no line geometry at all)
findings.interpretation_limits: region polygons are often drawn generously; the page image decides

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: region-level TextEquiv differs from the region's line texts joined by newlines
findings.interpretation_limits: Transkribus normally keeps both in sync; a mismatch shows an alternative text version, not which is newer

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: retained lines with |robust z| >= 4.0 of log(non-space chars / (crop w/h)) within their collection, or crop aspect >= 6.0 with <= 2 chars
examples: 0025_DSC_0403/r1l43 text_long_for_crop z=8.7 'wererat den Pähr Olsson igen m'
findings.interpretation_limits: per-collection medians: {'4502442': {'median_chars_per_height_unit': 3.667, 'mad_log': 0.3098}, '4502443': {'median_chars_per_height_unit': 4.541, 'mad_log': 0.2708}, '4502444': {'median_chars_per_height_unit': 4.7, 'mad_log': 0.1798}, '4502445': {'median_chars_per_height_unit': 4.265, 'mad_log': 0.2228}, '4502446': {'median_chars_per_height_unit': 4.16, 'mad_log': 0.1923}}. Short catchwords and numbers on wide polygons are normal; long text on short crops can be a baseline/polygon issue, not a GT issue.

findings.rule: TextLines with more than one TextEquiv (alternative text versions)

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: pages where PAGE and ALTO differ in line ids or by > 2% non-space characters (or ALTO missing)
findings.interpretation_limits: ALTO was exported from the same Transkribus transcript (2023); agreement shows export consistency, not transcription correctness

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: lines whose whitespace-collapsed text differs between PAGE and ALTO
findings.interpretation_limits: same limit as X1

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: duplicate page images / Transkribus pageIds / imageIds across all 14 export jobs, and duplicate filenames within a retained collection
findings.interpretation_limits: only one transcript version per page is exported; older versions are not visible

findings.label: DETERMINISTIC
findings.rule: PAGE-XML Creator lists an HTR model and layout-analysis tools (names only)
findings.interpretation_limits: shows the pages were machine-recognised at some point, not whether the text was corrected afterwards

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: pages whose last save followed the previous save in the same document within <= 1.0 s per line (machine speed) AND that carry no student convention (0 line-final '-' and 0 lines with [ or ??): likely recognition output that was never corrected
findings.interpretation_limits: 1539 retained lines are on these pages. The timing shows only the LAST save; the absence of '-' and editorial marks is indirect. The page images must confirm (manual queue).

findings.label: MANUAL SPOT-CHECK ONLY
findings.rule: pages with exactly one of the two T2 signals
findings.interpretation_limits: a fast final save after correction is possible; a page can also genuinely contain no hyphenated line-ends

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: pages mixing line-final '-' and '¬' (correction possibly stopped partway down the page)
findings.interpretation_limits: a student may also have used both marks deliberately

findings.label: HEURISTIC
findings.rule: share of word tokens (>= 3 letters, lowercased) on a page that never occur in the training-reference vocabulary (20114 types); median per collection and T2 class
findings.interpretation_limits: uncorrected recognition output should raise the rate, but so do names, places and the spelling of an earlier year; compare within a document, not across
